title: Ring of Feywild Sparks
summary: Forces Wild Magic surges while Tides of Chaos is active and grants +1 spell save DC.

fields.Feywild Sparks: While your Wild Magic Sorcerer’s Tides of Chaos is active, casting spells always triggers Wild Magic.
fields.Spell save DC: +1, even though the tooltip omits the bonus.
fields.Acquisition: Auntie Ethel at the Blushing Mermaid, X −2329, Y −95.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
